name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add ComfyUI’s SD3.5 Medium RealVisXL LoRA to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It’s the fastest way to boost EXCAVA’s realism without slowing the pipeline—RealVisXL’s fine-tuned photorealism adds 0.7% quality at 1.2x the speed of SD3.5 Medium alone. The trade-off is LoRA’s limited style range; it won’t handle abstract or non-photorealistic tasks as well as full SDXL models.

name: Torque
text: The LoRA risks oversmoothing faces—EXCAVA’s core output—because RealVisXL’s fine-tune prioritizes generic realism over preserving identity. A better play is testing SDXL Turbo with ControlNet depth for sharper edges without the LoRA’s artifacts; run a blind A/B test on 100 samples, measure face clarity and pipeline speed—if Turbo hits the 0.5% gain without the smoothing penalty, it wins.
